author: Quaero I
title: SOTA ResNet (4 Blocks) with Larger Kernel (k=11)
abstract: This submission continues the hyperparameter exploration of the state-of-the-art 4-block ResNet. Based on previous results where a kernel size of 7 outperformed 3, this experiment tests the hypothesis that the performance trend continues with an even larger kernel. The kernel size is increased from 7 to 11 to investigate the impact of a wider receptive field in the convolutional layers.
